items.description: Bookafy is an online scheduling and appointment tracking web app. This mashup makes use of the Zendesk Core API for ticket tracking and management.

Zendesk is a software as a service company that provides businesses with different communication tools. The Zendesk Core API enables developers to integrate the Zendesk platform into their applications. With this API, users of the applications will be able to use the core features of the Zendesk service, some of the features include setting limits on calls, automating calls, access to call records.

Allmyles provides bookable content integration for travel services. Developers can use the Allmyles API to integrate services for booking flights, hotels and car rentals. The services are RESTful and support both JSON and XML. Endpoints include Master data, Flight, Hotel, Car rental, and Booking. An API key is required.
Browse photos by Arab country name.
Take a video tour around London and add your own content to this graphically rich travel video mashup.
Call 847-416-1939 to find the current temperature of any US Zip Code. Used the Twilio API.
Java API wrapper library for Safe Creative copyright registry service.
Frtr (pronounced fritter) allows you to easily record then tweet a video recorded with your webcam.
A computer shopping site that makes extensive use of Amazons AWS service. The site is customized to return the best matching products available, allows you to track product prices, and more.

Customize a UK road trip, choose stop off points along the way - restaurants, cafes, petrol stations, child friendly venues - and also has an avoid motorways function. The route can be emailed and printed.
Google Maps + Twitter view of Unemployed in America. Tweets split into Eastern/Western United States.

Zapier is an application that integrates applications together. Users can choose triggers that automatically push data and content from one application to another.With Zapier, developers and users can integrate applications with API keys. Some example API methods include managing account information, performing various actions, and automating processes.
Calculate the number of calories you burn while running, bicycling, or swimming.
Gmarjil notifies you when certain Facebook friends are available, even when you are not online.

mite is a sleek online time tracking tool. Built in collaboration with the people who rely on it now: designers, developers, architects, and attorneys. Freelancers as well as small teams. mite lets you track your time in a structured way by breaking it down into customers, projects, and services. Track your time manually or with the built-in stop watch. Track it in the browser, on your Mac or PC, on your iPhone, via Twitter, Jabber or Ubiquity.

[As of September 16, 2013, This API has been deactivated and this page is being maintained purely for historical and research purposes.] Google Shopping Search lets developers create applications to search for products. Developers can create product comparison apps or provide search and discovery tools for users. The API simplifies access to product data and is optimized to deliver the most relevant product results.
Live traffic information for Lagos Nigeria overlaid on a map.

CoverSlide helps track down lost cover art for mp3s, movies, books, and video games. Ruby on Rails and Ajax make it convenient to select from a vast amount of cover art thumbnails to choose the perfect one without leaving the page.
Linkalope uses the Twitter API to search for recently shared links on Twitter. The built in zeitgeist pulls the latest trends making it easy to search for sports, movies, tv, celebrities, and more.
Compare new homes, home designs, builders, land estate, house plans, via Google Maps in Australia.

IceCharge is a fraud detection and prevention service that is built on top of a digital profiling algorithm. The service tries to identify legitimate transactions based on trying to check the consistency of the persona behind that transaction.
The redistricting following the 2010 Census is an opportunity to change how the redistricting process is conducted. With knowledge and the right tools, the public can redraw the map on redistricting.
